title: YUPI SDS-plus Concrete Drill Bit, 12mm Diameter, 160mm Total Length, 100mm Working Length, for AEG, Bosch, Hilti, Metabo
description: The YUPI 12mm Concrete Drill Bit by GT Global Traders is a robust and reliable tool designed for precision drilling in concrete, masonry, and similar hard surfaces. With a total length of 160mm and a working length of 100mm, this drill bit offers excellent reach and depth for a wide range of construction and renovation tasks. The 12mm diameter ensures clean, accurate holes every time. Featuring an SDS-plus shank type, it is compatible with leading power tool brands including AEG, Bosch, Hilti, and Metabo, making it a versatile addition to any professional or DIY toolkit. Manufactured to ISO 9001 quality standards, this drill bit is built to deliver consistent performance and durability even under demanding conditions. The four-flute spiral design aids in efficient debris removal, reducing heat build-up and prolonging the life of the bit. Whether you are mounting fixtures, installing anchors, or undertaking heavy-duty construction work, this YUPI drill bit is a dependable choice for getting the job done right.
